request.subject: CURIOSITY:LOST_EXPEDITION

layers.text: Erase everything except the khaki tent, the crates, the pith helmet, the rolled map and the journal: remove the green grass and the brown soil block under them completely, so the camp stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the tent, the crates, the helmet, the map, the journal, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
